name: Tom Nichols
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Citra (Citra Space Corporation, space domain awareness, Colorado Springs); co-founder of True Anomaly
profile: Air Force space-operations veteran who co-founded True Anomaly in 2022 with Even Rogers, Dan Brunski and Kyle Zakrzewski (the four met in the 4th Space Operations Squadron) and served as its COO/Chief Product Officer. In August 2024 he and Brunski left to co-found Citra, a veteran-owned company building telescopes, antennas, software and 'space superiority as a service' for space domain awareness, where he is CEO.
interesting_fact: True Anomaly, which he co-founded, raised a $650M Series D in 2026 and was selected by the US Space Force for space-based interceptor work; True Anomaly later hired a new COO (Sarah Walter) partly to fill the gap after his departure to start Citra.
deep_cut_fact: Even Rogers describes him as 'a natural leader, a wit, and deeply moral human.' At Citra he leads a team building in-house engines such as 'keplime' (orbital mechanics) and 'pixelemon' (high-speed space imagery processing).
notes: Common name - don't confuse with other Tom Nichols (e.g. the Atlantic writer). No longer at True Anomaly; reach via Citra. Citra tech source: https://citra.space/

name: Matt Krisiloff
current_role: CEO, Conception (Conception Biosciences, stem-cell-derived human eggs / in vitro gametogenesis)
profile: Matt Krisiloff is CEO of Conception, a Bay Area biotech using stem-cell biology and engineering to turn blood-derived stem cells into human eggs (in vitro gametogenesis), aiming to let people have children free of age and biological limits without IVF hormone injections or egg retrieval. Hurun lists him as founder of 'Science' (valued ~$2B); that company label could not be matched (Science Corp's leadership page does not list him).
interesting_fact: In June 2026 Conception announced it had generated the first early human egg cells (primary oocytes) from stem cells, made by converting blood cells into stem cells and growing miniature human ovaries in the lab.
notes: Identity flag: Hurun's company 'Science' does not match - Science Corp (science.xyz) lists Max Hodak et al., not Krisiloff. The only Matt Krisiloff found is Conception's CEO; verify which company Hurun meant before outreach. Web search budget was exhausted, so personal background (e.g. earlier career) was not verified.

name: Eldad Livni
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Innovation Officer (CINO), Torq (AI SOC / security hyperautomation platform)
profile: Eldad Livni co-founded Torq in 2020 with CEO Ofer Smadari and CTO Leonid Belkind to build no-code automation for security teams; Torq has since become an agentic 'AI SOC' platform with 430+ staff across the US, Canada, Israel and Europe. Torq raised a $140M Series D at a $1.2B valuation in January 2026 and acquired Jit in May 2026.
interesting_fact: Torq's Series D (Jan 2026) was led by cybersecurity fund Merlin Ventures to push into US federal/public-sector markets, with Bessemer, Insight Partners, Notable Capital, Evolution Equity and Greenfield all participating.
notes: Lowest public profile of the three Torq founders. Title per https://torq.io/company/ ; earlier Torq release (Aug 2022) also names him co-founder & Chief Innovation Officer. Prior-career details not verified (search budget exhausted).

name: Dylan Babbs
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Profound (AI search visibility / Answer Engine Optimization platform)
profile: Dylan Babbs co-founded Profound in 2024 with CEO James Cadwallader and leads its engineering. Profound tracks and optimizes how brands appear in ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and other answer engines, and now adds AI marketing agents; it raised a $96M Series C at $1B (Lightspeed, Feb 2026) and a $180M Series D at $1.8B led by Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins (Sep 2026).
interesting_fact: In about 14 months Profound grew from two founders with laptops to 82 people serving 1,000+ enterprise customers and outgrew three offices, before opening a second home in San Francisco in October 2025.
deep_cut_fact: He and James Cadwallader met 'in the hallways of South Park Commons' in New York City and deliberately chose NYC for its concentration of marketing and agency talent - Babbs wrote that they knew whatever they dedicated the next 10 years to would be built there.
notes: Valuation now $1.8B (Series D, Sep 2026 - https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/series-d). Technical co-founder; good fit for an AI-infrastructure conversation.
